name: newms-plugins
description: Personal plugin set: discipline, dev pipeline, danxbot orchestration

plugins.name: base
plugins.description: Universal discipline: bash exit capture, sub-agent delegation, tool usage, process kill, monitor polling. Install everywhere.

plugins.name: investigate
plugins.description: Read-only investigation methodology. Hypothesis → evidence → findings → options. NEVER applies fixes. For diagnostic agents (slack, dashboards, dev sessions before fix-writing).

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Code-writing discipline: TDD, debugging-with-fix, code quality, git safety. Install on instances that write code.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: Autonomous dev pipeline: pipe-start, pipe-review, pipe-quality, pipe-commit, pipe-report, pipe-finish, pipe-plan. Phase-by-phase code-writing flow that runs identically in human-loop and dispatched-worker contexts. Install on every code-writing instance.

plugins.name: human-collaboration
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop discipline: read-only-default (human-loop skill), host-environment, docs/explain. Install only where a human drives prompts. Do NOT install on autonomous dispatched workers (diagnostic-mode-on-question would deadlock).

plugins.name: danxbot
plugins.description: Danxbot orchestrator: dispatch architecture, runtime modes, deploy, issue-card workflow (YAML schema, tracker contract, danx-issue MCP), autonomous issue-worker skills (danx-start, danx-next, danx-ideate, danx-triage-card, danx-epic-link), unblock, halt-flag, no-unauthorized-worker-launch, comment-style. Single home for everything danxbot-related — install on every danxbot-aware instance + workspace.
